legacy.text: Skip to main content CrowAgent Products Pricing Blog FAQ About ⌘K Sign in Request access COMPARE › CROWMARK VS CLEANTENDER HONEST COMPARISON CrowMark vs CleanTender A soft-FM specialist against a sector-agnostic bid suite. Both publish their prices, so the real question is scope. Every competitor fact is sourced and dated. Updated 26 July 2026 CrowMark is a sector-agnostic UK bid and tender management suite priced from £49 per month. CleanTender is a soft facilities-management specialist, with a free tier and Pro at £99 per month, tuned for cleaning, security, grounds, waste and catering bids. Both publish their pricing, so this is not a transparency contest. It is a question of scope and depth, and this page sets out both honestly with dated sources. At a glance CrowMark compared with CleanTender across category, features and pricing FEATURE CROWMARK CLEANTENDER Category UK bid and tender management suite (all sectors) Soft-FM bid tool (cleaning, security, grounds, waste, catering) UK tender discovery Yes, Contracts Finder + Find a Tender, daily at 06:00, all sectors Curated soft-FM feed from official UK sources Sector coverage Sector-agnostic Soft FM only Bid qualification / fit scan In development, not in the released product Yes, 0 to 100 in under 30 seconds Drafting grounded in your own answer library Yes SQ drafting with soft-FM vocabulary, unlimited drafts on Pro Figure-grounding (AI blocked from inventing a number) Yes, deterministic gate Not stated publicly PPN 017 AI-use disclosure on every draft Yes Not stated publicly PPN 002 social value (10% floor) Yes, deterministic calculation Included as a TOMs / Social Value SQ section Post-award delivery evidence (Procurement Act 2023 s.52 / s.71) Yes Not stated Published price Yes Yes Starting price £49/month (Starter) Free tier; Pro £99/month or £990/year Best for UK suppliers bidding across sectors UK soft-FM SMEs doing 4 to 12 bids a year What is CleanTender? CleanTender is a UK bid tool built specifically for soft facilities management: cleaning, security, grounds, waste and catering. It curates a feed of soft-FM tenders from official UK public-sector sources, and its qualification scan reads a contract pack and scores your stored profile against it from 0 to 100 in under 30 seconds. On its Pro plan it drafts Selection Questionnaire responses in the standard sections, including Company Overview, Relevant Experience, Quality Assurance, Staff Training, COSHH Management and a Social Value and TOMs section, with the sector vocabulary these bids expect, such as BICSc, SIA ACS, TUPE and NHS national specifications. That specialisation is a real advantage, and it is one CrowMark does not try to match. If cleaning or security is all you bid for, CleanTender's vocabulary and its fast fit scan are built around exactly your work, and its pricing is public: a free tier to browse the contract directory, and Pro at £99 per month or £990 per year, which adds the qualification scan, unlimited drafts, the Compliance Vault and email alerts. CleanTender positions itself for soft-FM SMEs doing roughly 4 to 12 bids a year. What is CrowMark? CrowMark is CrowAgent's UK bid and tender management suite. Unlike a sector specialist, it is sector-agnostic: it tracks Contracts Finder and Find a Tender across any category, refreshed every morning at 06:00. It drafts answers cited to the regulations, to the tender's own clauses and to the supplier's answer library, and its defining rule is figure-grounding, so before a draft is shown, every £ and % is checked against a set of allowed figures computed from your own data, and if a number is not in that set the draft is rejected. Every AI-assisted draft carries a PPN 017 AI-use disclosure and waits for a person to approve it. CrowMark calculates PPN 002 social value deterministically in code against the 10% minimum weighting rather than only drafting it as a questionnaire section, and after award it tracks each commitment to a delivery percentage with a RAG status, captures evidence, issues monthly reports and checks the Procurement Act 2023 KPI duties in sections 52 and 71. Its bid-fit and coverage marking, by contrast, is still in development and not in the released product, so on the fit-scan row above CleanTender is genuinely ahead today. The post-award evidence tracker in CrowMark, shown with a sample account. The coverage figures are sample data from that account, not a customer result. CrowMark publishes its pricing. Starter is £49 per month for 3 users, Pro is £149 per month for 10 users with post-award delivery tracking, and Portfolio is contact sales. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial. Pricing compared Both tools publish their prices, so you can compare directly. CleanTender is free to browse and £99 per month on Pro. CrowMark is £49 per month on Starter and £149 per month on Pro. For a soft-FM supplier, CleanTender Pro at £99 sits between CrowMark's two paid tiers, and the deciding factor is scope rather than price: CleanTender covers soft FM deeply, CrowMark covers every sector plus deterministic social value and post-award delivery. Which should you choose? Choose CleanTender if Cleaning, security, grounds, waste or catering is most or all of what you bid. You want sector vocabulary such as BICSc, SIA ACS, COSHH and TUPE built in. You want a fast qualification scan to decide whether to bid. Pro at £99 per month with unlimited drafts fits your budget. Choose CrowAgent (CrowMark) if You bid across more than one sector on Contracts Finder and Find a Tender. You want the AI blocked from inventing a figure, with a PPN 017 disclosure on every draft. You need deterministic PPN 002 social value maths, not just a drafted section. You want post-award delivery evidence under the Procurement Act 2023. Where CrowMark loses honestly For a pure soft-FM contractor, CleanTender is the more specialised tool. Its vocabulary is tuned to cleaning and security bids, its curated feed filters out the noise of other sectors, and its qualification scan gives a fast bid or no-bid signal, an area where CrowMark's own fit marking is not yet released. CrowMark's advantage is breadth and depth on the compliance side: every sector, a hard figure-grounding gate, deterministic PPN 002 maths and post-award delivery evidence. If you only ever bid for cleaning contracts, that breadth is not worth much to you, and CleanTender may simply be the better fit. A soft-FM supplier who also bids in other categories could reasonably run both. Frequently asked questions Is CrowMark or CleanTender cheaper? What sectors does CleanTender cover? Does CleanTender handle social value? Which finds more tenders? Does CleanTender have a qualification score? Which handles post-award delivery? I run a cleaning company, which should I use? Can I use both CrowMark and CleanTender?
